# Discussion Template

> Copy this template into `docs/discussions/DISC_NNN-<slug>.md` when
> initiating a discussion. Fill in the sections below.

## Title

Brief, descriptive title of the discussion topic.

- **Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Status**: Open
- **Author**: discussion-architect agent
- **Related Decision**: (populated once decided)

## Context

Describe the background, problem, or motivation that prompted this discussion.
Include any relevant constraints, dependencies, or links to existing code.

## Problem Statement

What is the specific question or problem being addressed? Be concrete.

## Options

### Option A

Description of the first option. Include pros and cons.

### Option B

Description of the second option. Include pros and cons.

### Option C

(Add as many options as needed.)

## Trade-offs

Summarize the key trade-offs between the options: cost, complexity, risk,
performance, maintainability, team familiarity, etc.

## Recommendation

(Leave blank until iterated.) Initial leaning and rationale.

## Iteration Log

### 2024-01-01 -- Initial proposal

- Comment on the initial state as submitted.

## Approval

- **Approved By**: *(name, once approved)*
- **Decision Record**: *(path to ADR once created)*
- **Implementation Plan**: *(path to plan once created)*
